# Indonesian question explanations — batch 004 — 2026-10-14

## Scope

Translated the next 100 source-ordered Indonesian question explanations. The batch covers subject–verb agreement, word forms, past and future perfect, third and mixed conditionals, reported speech, participle clauses, wish, inversion, and modal perfects.

Every explanation was authored from its English source explanation in `content/en/questions.json`. Question stems, options, answers, stable IDs, and taught English forms remain unchanged.
